description: This file defines a LightningJS component named 'Loader' that displays animated circles as a loading indicator with fade-in and fade-out transitions.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A LightningJS component for displaying a loading animation with three animated circles.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts an interval that toggles the alpha property between 0 and 1 to animate the circles' fade-in and fade-out effect.
